name: margaryan-content-studio
description: ChatGPT-native tools for editable 1–192-second motion-graphics film storyboards, browser-rendered video, and keyless customer film production. An independent Motion Studio plugin.

interface.shortDescription: Plan and revise real animated films with ChatGPT and Motion Studio
interface.longDescription: Create 1–64-second motion storyboards, revise scenes and plan multi-chapter films up to 192 seconds from ChatGPT. Preview and export genuine procedural video in Motion Studio with no separate OpenAI API key. Device browser codecs and rendering performance apply.
defaultPrompt: Create a premium 30-second portrait motion-graphics film for my brand. Use only truthful claims.
Make a 120-second two-act animated film storyboard for my product, with a clear opening and closing.
Revise scene two in my existing Motion Studio film and change the headline.
